W11_VILLAIN.speaker: Lord Kaan
W11_VILLAIN.title: The equal throne
W11_VILLAIN.text: A Force vision shows a future Sith Lord named Kaan. He promises every Lord a throne in a Brotherhood of Darkness.

W11_VILLAIN.speaker: Darth Bane
W11_VILLAIN.title: A listener in the dark
W11_VILLAIN.text: The vision returns: one voice does not join the applause. Bane records the names of the Lords and the cost of making all of them equal.

react.light: He hears your order spare prisoners, and calls mercy a weakness he cannot yet explain.
react.dark: He hears how fear bought obedience, and recognizes Kaan’s bargain in your ranks.

W11_VILLAIN.speaker: Lord Kaan
W11_VILLAIN.title: The army of Lords
W11_VILLAIN.text: Kaan addresses the Brotherhood before Ruusan: every blade is a Lord, every Lord a share of victory.

W11_VILLAIN.speaker: Darth Bane
W11_VILLAIN.title: The arithmetic of power
W11_VILLAIN.text: Bane counts losses after each charge. A thousand Sith strike as one and still leave a thousand claims to command.

react.light: The captured wounded are returned. Bane wonders why the Jedi can afford restraint.
react.dark: The reports of your harsh orders travel faster than your army. Bane calls that useful, then doubts it.
react.death: The name {fallen} on your memorial rolls reaches Bane. He marks what Kaan spends without counting.
react.arc: A squad member chose a harder path and stayed. Bane sees loyalty that Kaan cannot command.

W11_VILLAIN.speaker: Lord Kaan
W11_VILLAIN.title: The caves answer
W11_VILLAIN.text: Kaan gathers the Brotherhood below Ruusan. The ritual tablets call for every Lord to give the Force a single wound.

W11_VILLAIN.speaker: Darth Bane
W11_VILLAIN.title: A different succession
W11_VILLAIN.text: Bane watches the seventh battle collapse. He writes two names in the margin of Kaan’s order: master and apprentice.

react.light: Your answer is to pull survivors from the line. Bane has no place for that in his new rule.
react.dark: Your use of fear proves power can narrow to one will. Bane decides even one is too many unless another can challenge it.
react.death: {fallen} is named in the intercepted report. Bane crosses out the word victory.
react.arc: A squad choice changed its future. Bane sees that choices outlive armies.

W11_VILLAIN.speaker: Lord Kaan
W11_VILLAIN.title: The last weapon
W11_VILLAIN.text: Kaan calls every Lord into the thought bomb. Bane does not answer the summons.

W11_VILLAIN.speaker: Darth Bane
W11_VILLAIN.title: Two in the ashes
W11_VILLAIN.text: The thought bomb ends Kaan’s Brotherhood. Bane sees its end and gives his doctrine its name: the Rule of Two.

outcome.win: Your squad broke the ritual. Bane must build his new order from a defeat.
outcome.lose: The bomb fired. Bane walks from the silence certain that Kaan destroyed himself.

W11_VILLAIN.speaker: Darth Bane
W11_VILLAIN.title: An old holocron
W11_VILLAIN.text: Centuries later, a sealed recording speaks in Bane’s voice. Kaan’s Brotherhood is gone; the Rule of Two was built to survive it.

react.light: Your archive keeps the warning in reach. A student asks how to spot a master who hides.
react.dark: The archive is sealed by fear. A student hears the voice alone.
react.arc: The record of an old squad choice survives beside the holocron. A student reads both.
react.death: {fallen}’s name still stands by the archive door. The student reads it before opening the vault.

W11_VILLAIN.speaker: Darth Bane
W11_VILLAIN.title: The unanswered warning
W11_VILLAIN.text: The vision of Ruusan returns as the frontier burns. Bane’s lesson was patience; the Order must decide what to learn from Kaan’s failure.
